principles: Send Gmail START and persist provider message_id before substantive work.

Target 23 minutes of useful work inside a 25-minute wall-clock tranche; close earlier only for a true human gate, tool/safety failure, or completed atomic action that should not be artificially prolonged.
Reserve the final 2 minutes for closeout; do not start optional product mutations after minute 23.
The ChatGPT visible thinking-duration indicator is not authoritative for total work and must never be presented as proof of tranche duration.
PRIMARY_ASSISTANT owns normal END delivery. Normal closeout must not depend on automations or watchdogs.
Persist CLOSE_INTENT before END, search Gmail by delivery_key, send exactly once if missing, persist END_ACKNOWLEDGED/CLOSED, then reply in ChatGPT.
Every tranche ends with durable evidence: commits/tests/readbacks/receipts and next atomic action.
limitations: This policy guides BCP/project work; it cannot retroactively rewrite past ChatGPT conversations.
ChatGPT itself does not continue executing after a response unless invoked again; resident BCP components may continue independently where implemented.

measurement_truth.chatgpt_thinking_indicator: NOT_AUTHORITATIVE; MAY_BE MUCH SHORTER_THAN TOTAL_TOOL_ORCHESTRATION; NEVER_USED_AS_WORK_PROOF
